description: This file defines data structures, enums, and a singleton class (HealthStore) for managing and displaying health status information within a macOS SwiftUI application related to OpenClaw. It includes models for health snapshots, logic for refreshing and decoding health data, and methods for interpreting health states and errors.

classes.name: HealthStore
classes.description: A singleton observable class that manages the current health snapshot, refreshes data periodically or on demand, and provides UI-friendly status summaries and error details.

methods.name: __setSnapshotForTest
methods.description: Test-only method to set a custom health snapshot and error for testing purposes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the periodic refresh loop for health data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches fresh health data from the control channel, decoding and updating the snapshot or setting errors as needed.

methods.name: isChannelHealthy
methods.description: Determines if a channel summary is healthy based on configuration and probe status.

methods.name: describeProbeFailure
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of a probe failure.

methods.name: resolveLinkChannel
methods.description: Resolves the linked health channel from the snapshot, favoring linked channels.

methods.name: resolveFallbackChannel
methods.description: Finds a fallback healthy channel, excluding a specified id.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable reason for health failure based on the snapshot.
